{{Top|leg}}
The '''BD-series''' was a line of [[medium freighter]]s produced by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. For a time, the BD-series was popular among smaller shipping companies until [[Container ship/Legends|container ships]] became the most economical way to transport cargo. The [[BD-27 Transport]] was part of the BD-series.
